blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.markdown:
| When the reading value is...   | Then...                                                                                                                                                                 |
|--------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Negative                       | The pump coupling half (X) is lower than the driver coupling half (Y). Remove shims of a thickness equal to half of the indicator reading value under each driver foot. |
| Positive                       | The pump coupling half (X) is higher than the driver coupling half (Y). Add shims of a thickness equal to half of the indicator reading value to each driver foot.      |

blocks.content: You must use an equal amount of shims with each driver foot to prevent misalignment. Failure to do so can result in equipment damage or decreased performance.
Figure 13: Side view of an incorrect vertical alignment
Repeat the previous steps until the permitted reading value is achieved.

NOTICE: The specified permitted reading values are valid only at operating temperature. For cold settings, other values are permitted. You must use the correct tolerances. Failure to do so can result in misalignment and reduced pump reliability.

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: A unit is in parallel alignment when the parallel indicator (P) does not vary by more than 0.002 in. (0.05 mm) as measured at four points 90° apart at the operating temperature.

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Set the parallel alignment indicator (P) to zero on the left side of  the driver coupling half  (Y), 90° from the top-center position (9 o'clock).

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Rotate the indicator through the top-center position to the right side, 180° from the start position (3 o'clock).

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Slide the driver carefully in the appropriate direction.

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.markdown:
| When the reading value is...   | Then...                                                                     |
|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Negative                       | The driver coupling half (Y) is to the left of the pump coupling half (X).  |
| Positive                       | The driver coupling half (Y) is to the right of the pump coupling half (X). |

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: NOTICE: Make sure to slide the driver evenly. Failure to do so can negatively affect horizontal angular correction.
